title: rhinanthus minor var. minor
intro: Rhinanthus minor var. minor, commonly known as Lesser Yellow Rash or Yellow Bartsia, is a plant species belonging to the Bartsia genus. It is used in herbal medicine for its purported health benefits, including its potential to treat digestive issues, colds, and fever. The plant is believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its medicinal uses. The bioactive constituents of Rhinanthus minor var. minor include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, although further research is necessary to confirm its full range of bioactive compounds and their effects on human health.
